items.evidence: Log shows 40 uL aspirated from beads_reservoir A1 and dispensed into each of the 96 sample wells, followed by 10 aspirate/dispense mix pairs; the 5 min incubation comment precedes the magnet comment.
The magnet-engage and settle comment is recorded. 90 uL is removed from every well to waste A1, then two rounds of 200 uL ethanol are added and each is fully removed to waste (log lines 2306-4224).
The air-dry (5 min) and disengage comments are recorded. 50 uL water is added to each well and mixed 10 times, and the 2 min incubation and magnet re-engage comment follows (log lines 4226-6528).
Log lines 6530-6911 show 45 uL aspirated from each sample_plate well and dispensed into the same well of elution_plate (A1->A1 ... H12->H12).
Every well in each step has its own pick up tip and drop tip (supernatant, ethanol removal, water, elution), so no tip touches two samples.

judge.summary: The protocol performs all 96 wells for every pipetting step with the correct volumes, mix counts and well-matched transfers. The incubation, magnet, dry and disengage steps are only recorded as comments, which the task allows. A fresh tip is used for every sample at every step.
